previous_studies.policy: No retuning previous frozen strategies. Jan 2025-Oct 2026 Exness history is exploratory only, not untouched OOS.

primary_hypothesis: When trailing quote-driven volatility is large enough relative to executable roundtrip cost, a past-only state classifier can identify a 120-300-second directional trade with positive broker-feasible net payoff after slippage, spread, commissions, margin and hard stop risk; else NO_TRADE.
symbol: EURUSDm indicative Bid/Ask; broker-specific stop level and fill audit required
feature_clock: UTC, millisecond ticks in original source sequence; preserve same-time quote changes; do not interpolate prices across missing quotes

sampling.kind: past-only event-driven, not 10-minute fixed calendar sampling
sampling.sessions: 07:00:00 <= anchor <= 15:54:00 UTC on FX trading days with quotes
qualifications: at least 20 quotes in preceding 60 seconds
midpoint high-low range in preceding 120 seconds >= 3*(anchor spread points + 2 points baseline roundtrip slip)
reference quotes to calculate 10,30,60,120 second features must be at/before anchor and no older than 2 seconds vs reference boundary
minimum 360 seconds since preceding accepted ANCHOR even if no trade or outcome censored; use first eligible quote after cooldown
sampling.policy: One event/row, both long/short counterfactuals are correlated outcomes not independent observations; accept same-timestamp source ordering. Explicit missing outcomes, no forward fill >2 sec.

features_past_only: midpoint range and sum absolute tick moves 30,60,120 seconds
update quote counts 5,30,60,120 seconds and 5/60 relative update ratio
current, trailing-60s mean and 90th percentile spread points

execution.commission_status: Exness Standard public assumption only; require actual account verification
execution.swap: 0 only when position actually closed before broker rollover; otherwise charge actual swap or invalidate
execution.spread: recorded bid/ask tick stream; no mid-price fills
execution.entry: first quote at/after signal time +100ms, at most 2000ms late; BUY at Ask+slip and SELL at Bid-slip; fail/skip on stale quote
execution.stop_points: ceil(max(40,1.5*previous 60-second midpoint range in points)); skip if >80
execution.stop_order: broker-registered SL/TP at entry; BUY trigger using Bid, SELL using Ask; fill on next quote after modeled 100ms broker trigger-to-fill delay with adverse slip and gap risk
execution.margin: contract_eur*actual_ask_or_bid/leverage, check available equity/free margin and broker stopout level; one simultaneous position per independent strategy
execution.risk: planned total stop cash loss including modeled slip and commission <=2% current equity, 0.01 lot fixed; gap losses may exceed planned risk; reject if StopsLevel/FreezeLevel prohibit registered stop
execution.exit: first SL/TP, then 300s time limit, no overnight or unidentified incomplete exits
stress: spread 1.5x and 2.0x around unchanged midpoint with fully chronological stop/TP replay

labels.secondary_horizon: 120 seconds descriptive only; no choosing winning horizon after results
labels.counterfactual: On each anchor simulate BUY and SELL separately with the SAME registered SL/TP, 300-second max hold, costs/margin/quote gaps; no real simultaneous funded opposing positions
labels.class_rule: NO_TRADE=0 unless a side has fully simulated net PnL>+$0.03 and exceeds the other side; LONG=1 if long net higher; SHORT=2 if short net higher; censor if outcome not executable at quote timestamp
labels.objective: expected realized barrier-exit Trading PnL with risk gate (not classification hit rate and not raw 300s midpoint movement)

models.control: ALWAYS_NO_TRADE, zero discretionary trades; helps assess overtrading not a viable profit-generating model
models.simple_rule: Baseline momentum continuation: if trailing 60-second midpoint move >=+20 points buy; <=-20 points sell; otherwise NO_TRADE; all prequalifications, SL/TP and cost/risk gates still apply
models.decision: For each class, compute TRAINING-ONLY conditional mean realized BUY and SELL barrier payoff, multiply by predict_proba to get expected net dollar payoffs; take side iff predicted EV>=+0.03 USD and exceeds other side by >=0.02 USD, then apply prequalifications and risk gates; otherwise NO_TRADE
models.model_weights: trained only on 2025-2026 pre-inspected exploratory history and SHA-frozen BEFORE inspecting any future validation outcomes; no retraining during independent test

validation.retrospective: 2025-01 to 2026-10 previously examined; development-only exploratory expanding walk-forward; purge all labels crossing evaluation fold boundary with >=360s embargo; no title clean-OOS
validation.prospective_embargo: Archived raw future quotes must not be inspected for target labels or used for feature selection, tuning, or fitting until model weights and code are SHA-sealed; if not sealed, do not retroactively declare those dates clean OOS.
acceptance: positive net Trading PnL and expectancy after executable Bid/Ask+slip+commission+swap+margin costs
day-block bootstrap 2000 draws fixed seed 23001, Holm familywise 0.05 adjustment across baseline momentum, Logistic and LightGBM; lower 95% adjusted confidence bound for mean net/trade >0
max intratick marked-to-market equity DD <=$20 for $100 initial equity
stress expectancy positive and stress PF>=1.0 in each predeclared stress scenario
>=60% of complete prospective months positive, no one month contributes >50% of positive gross month profits
no unresolved position, unregistered broker stop, or unaccounted open equity
broker-calibrated request/deal latency, stopsLevel/freezeLevel, reject counts, swap, commission and margin/stopout must be documented
validation.selection: At most one strategy after all gates pass; if none pass => NO_EDGE. Do not increase lot/leverage to rescue losing strategy.
validation.reporting: Monthly net USD PnL, BUY/SELL trades, PF, expectancy, win rate (descriptive), intratick max DD, max loss streak, cost decomposition, session/spread/volatility quantile, missed/censored quotes, trade eligibility funnel, comparison against simple and ALWAYS_NO_TRADE baseline.

governance: Never relabel V20–V22 historical data as untouched prospective; code/threshold edits get a new prereg ID and a fresh future cutoff; no bot for live money without separate authorization.
